title: I've been building a browser FPS where you can bring down the entire city
author: Affectionate_Tie6915
selftext:
So I've been messing around with Claude Code and ended up making this game called East Bank.

It's basically a battle royale FPS where you drop into a city, grab guns, fight bots or another player, and try to survive. One thing I really wanted was to make the map destructible, so you can actually blow up parts of buildings instead of just shooting at walls that do nothing lol.

There's also tanks, a plane, different guns, loot, bombs, etc. You can play it right in your browser too, no download needed.

I used Claude Code for pretty much the whole thing. The first build was done with 3 prompts using Fable 5.2 Ultra Code, then I used Opus 5.5 a lot to fix stuff, tweak things and get the smaller details right.

Still got a lot I wanna improve, but it's playable now so figured I'd share it here.

Here's the link:  
[https://eastbank.fly.dev/](https://eastbank.fly.dev/)

Would be cool to hear what you guys think. Especially curious what other people here have been able to build with AI.  
  
(Btw, you can try the game for free! There's a small $3 fee if you want to keep playing beyond that. Hosting and running everything isn't free, so it just helps cover some of the server costs. No pressure, just wanted to make it accessible for people to try!)
